title: Resolution urging Albany to add license points for illegal racing
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass S.1768/A.2585, the Drag Racing and Speeding Enforcement Act. The bill would add five points to a driver's license upon conviction for participating in illegal speed contests or drag races, a penalty not currently imposed under state law. The Council notes that current law already allows criminal penalties for such offenses but lacks this license-point consequence.
